Lessons.Title: The Parabola
ExplanationParagraphs: A parabola is the set of points equidistant from a focus and a directrix.
Use signs of p to determine opening orientation.
Parabolic reflectors place receivers at focus; p=radius²/(4depth).
Independent Cool-down: identify the standard conic, state relevant foci/axis features, and verify the equation with an independent point.
